scripts.test: pnpm --filter @votion/types run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && vitest run
scripts.test:transformer: pnpm --filter @votion/types run build && vitest run test/transformer.test.ts
scripts.test:query: pnpm --filter @votion/types run build && vitest run test/query.test.ts
scripts.test:client: pnpm --filter @votion/types run build && vitest run test/client.test.ts
scripts.test:components: pnpm --filter @votion/types run build && vitest run test/components.test.ts test/highlight.test.ts test/recent-pages.test.ts test/controller.test.ts test/provision.test.ts
scripts.provision: pnpm --filter @votion/types run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node dist/scripts/provision.js
